profileEvidence.summary: Affectionate after time to settle, Billy the Kid was described by his foster as a devoted cuddle companion. This adult Bassoodle, a Basset Hound–Poodle cross, followed his foster around and enjoyed walks, car rides and yard play. Confinement was harder: the rescue reported whining and escaping his crate. These are observations of one dog, rather than a fixed temperament for the cross.
